templates.title: Name Correction Affidavit
templates.body: I solemnly affirm that my old and corrected names belong to the same person.

templates.title: Domicile Affidavit
templates.body: I declare that I am a permanent resident and the information furnished is true.

templates.title: Loss of CNIC
templates.body: I solemnly declare that my CNIC has been lost and despite best efforts could not be recovered.

templates.title: Income Affidavit
templates.body: I hereby declare that the income details stated herein are true and correct.
